summary: Set within an idyllic rural setting along Burtree Lane, on the outskirts of Darlington, this exceptional country estate presents a rare and versatile opportunity, extending to approximately 10 acres of beautifully positioned land.
description: At its heart lies a truly stunning seven-bedroom barn conversion, expertly designed to blend characterful charm with contemporary living. Showcasing an abundance of space, natural light, and bespoke finishes throughout, the barn offers an impressive yet welcoming family home, perfectly suited for both everyday living and elegant entertaining. Complementing this is a self-contained annexe, ideal for multi-generational living, guest accommodation, or independent rental potential. Further enhancing the estate is a substantial six-bedroom detached farmhouse dating back to the late 1800s. Rich in heritage and original character, this residence offers immense scope for refinement or continued use as a separate dwelling, creating a unique dual-living arrangement within the grounds. The property is equally impressive externally, with extensive outbuildings and well-established equestrian facilities, making it perfectly suited for those with lifestyle or business aspirations. Whether utilised for private equestrian use, commercial ventures, or further development (subject to necessary permissions), the possibilities here are truly exceptional. In addition, the current owner has constructed a high-quality cedar wood and brick garage, thoughtfully designed and offering clear potential for conversion into a further annexe or bespoke accommodation, adding yet another layer of flexibility to this already remarkable estate. Enjoying a peaceful yet highly accessible location, this outstanding property offers the perfect balance of countryside tranquillity and convenience, with Darlington's amenities and transport links just a short distance away. Offering a wealth of opportunity-from extended family living to business use or future development-this is a truly unique and captivating estate where the potential is as expansive as the grounds themselves. Approached with a true sense of arrival, the estate is discreetly set behind substantial boundary walls, ensuring exceptional privacy and seclusion. Accessed via impressive wrought iron, remote-controlled double gates, the property immediately establishes its grandeur. Beyond, a sweeping gravelled driveway unfolds, elegantly connecting all principal dwellings and creating a cohesive yet expansive layout within the grounds. The exterior spaces have been thoughtfully designed to offer both functionality and tranquillity. A series of beautifully arranged patio seating areas and an intimate inner courtyard provide sheltered spots for relaxation and entertaining, all enjoying a high degree of privacy. The extensive grounds also offer generous parking provisions, comfortably accommodating numerous vehicles, motorhomes, and caravans-making the estate ideally suited for those seeking to operate a home-based business or lifestyle enterprise. The barn conversion itself is a masterpiece of design and craftsmanship. Internally, it boasts magnificent vaulted ceilings that enhance the sense of scale and light, while striking exposed brick chimney breasts serve as architectural centrepieces, celebrating the building's heritage. Underfloor heating runs throughout, supported by a state-of-the-art heating system, ensuring year-round comfort, while satellite television is installed across multiple rooms for modern convenience. At the heart of the home lies an outstanding open-plan kitchen and family room-an exceptional space designed for both everyday living and sophisticated entertaining. This stunning hub effortlessly combines style and practicality, making it ideal for family gatherings and social occasions alike. The accommodation is further complemented by four luxurious, spa-inspired bathrooms, each finished to an exceptional standard, alongside several versatile reception rooms that can be tailored to suit a variety of lifestyle needs-whether formal entertaining, home working, or leisure spaces. Throughout, the barn conversion showcases superior quality and attention to detail, with an array of remarkable features that elevate it far beyond the ordinary. The detached farmhouse has also been beautifully renovated, offering an equally impressive living environment. It comprises six well-proportioned bedrooms, three elegant bathrooms, and three inviting reception rooms, all thoughtfully arranged to create a warm and characterful home. In addition, a self-contained living area with its own private entrance opening onto the gardens provides further flexibility-perfect for extended family or guest accommodation. Completing the estate's impressive array of features is a practical tack room, fitted with drainage to allow for easy wash-down-an invaluable addition for equestrian use and day-to-day functionality. Viewing is strictly by appointment only and is highly recommended in order to fully appreciate the scale, quality, and unique lifestyle opportunity offered by this truly exceptional and hidden gem of a property.
